headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Munsif Daily / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu / India Today
bullets_en: Actor Imran Khan is an American citizen, alleges former BJP MP.
Tension at Champapet School over Denial of Entry to Students Wearing Durga Mata Mala.
BJD slams State government for Hockey India’s notice to downgrade Odisha’s status.
Marathi actor Madhu Kambikar dies at 73, CM Devendra Fadnavis pays tribute.
Nagarkurnool, Narayanpet Win National Awards for Agricultural Initiatives.
bullets_ur: Adakar Imran Khan Amriki shehri hain, sabqa BJP MP ka ilzam.
Durga Mata Mala pehnay talba ko dakhlay se roknay par Champapet School mein kashidgi.
Hockey India ke Odisha ka status kam karne ke notice par BJD ne riyasati hukumat par tanqeed ki.
Marathi adakar Madhu Kambikar 73 saal ki umar mein chal basin, CM Devendra Fadnavis ka khiraj-e-aqeedat.
Nagarkurnool aur Narayanpet ne zarai iqdamat par National Awards jeet liye.
